reverse_last_trade.rule: Per pair last-3 fills (newest first). May reverse any unreversed fill in that window once if profitable. Normal reverse eff% = min(5.0, max(0.20, composed)). Reverse of a band_rebalance or underweight_double fill (including legacy friday_rebalance and friday_band_rebalance): eff% = min(5.0, max(0.20, 2 * composed)), leftover floor still on top. composed = biased base x own-pair mult x loss tilt x skip-halving. Reverse of an rsi_rebalance fill is a flat 5%: that replaces composed, the 2x multiplier, the 0.20 floor, and the leftover floor. It is not 5% plus leftover and it is not doubled. rsi_rebalance is not remapped to band_rebalance. After any of those reverses fill, mark the source fill reversed and store the reverse as kind edge (reversed false). Best net among clearing reverses on a pair; one fill per pair per check. Different pairs may all fill in the same check. Do not change multipliers or the same-pair streak when tagging a rebalance fill.

underweight_double.rule: On the daily morning balance check only: for each of SOL/cbBTC/WETH (never USDC as the buy target), if that token’s live USD value is <5% of total wallet USD, execute a buy on the best net of Jupiter manual (swap/v2/build, platformFeeBps=0) and Raydium (never Orca, never Phantom, never Jupiter Ultra) that doubles its quantity, funded by selling the current heaviest USD holding. Size still respects max 15% of combined portfolio, ≤40% of sold balance, ≥0.02 SOL fee buffer, and fee-inclusive net (gas_net). Prefer one rebalance fill per underweight asset per morning; if heaviest cannot fund full double under size caps, buy as much as caps allow then note remainder. Does not require normal edge % — this is a portfolio floor rebalance, but still must clear quote=execution and not lose after all fees beyond dust. The 5% denominator is SOL, USDC, cbBTC, and WETH only. JitoSOL and Greedy Goats are not in that total.

day_loss_stop.rule: If PT calendar day realized+unrealized net is down ≥50% vs day-start wallet USD, pause trading for the rest of that PT day and notify once. (Was $50 absolute.)

quote_cap.rank_by: estimated fee-inclusive gap_net (USD marks from the SOL probe + Jupiter lite price/v3, flat gas estimate) vs required %
quote_cap.pool: all 12 directed basis routes plus every unreversed last-3-window reverse candidate
quote_cap.prefilter: fade_trend, RSI-unwind (basis), same-pair streak cap never take a quote slot
quote_cap.rule: Each edge check ranks every directed route and window reverse by how close it is to clearing and fully Jupiter+Raydium quotes only the top 5 (fewer if fewer candidates). The top-1 of those also gets an Orca Whirlpool quote when orca_top1 is on (off). Reverse fills older than reverse_last_trade.max_age_hours are expired. Route hit-rate cooldown may defer cold routes (fill remaining slots with best cooled). Fresh re-quote before a send, the Raydium fallback, and the Alchemy re-quote stay limited to those. Locked 2026-10-05.
